author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Standing figure with arms raised out from the shoulders and legs apart, as in the reference pose, in the shared stick-figure style. The current drawing's arms and legs met almost at one point on a 6-unit torso, so the body read as an X with a ring above it rather than a person.
omissions: The reference's outlined gingerbread silhouette is drawn as a stick figure (house human style); an outlined 8-wide-limb version was tried and read as a W/hug shape at 48.
